context: After the homepage exchange-shell migration, production evidence showed the narrow-desktop layout still using legacy hero-header grid/decorative rules inside the new fixed sidebar, leaving the rail oversized/empty and squeezing the trading workspace. Mobile was already acceptable.
root_cause: Legacy xrbc-hero-nav class kept high-specificity !important grid and decorative header rules active.
Homepage sidebar-to-top-nav collapse waited until 900px, which was too late for narrow desktop/tablet widths.
repair: Removed xrbc-hero-nav from the homepage header so legacy hero-header grid/decorative rules no longer compete with the exchange shell.
Moved the homepage-specific fixed-sidebar collapse breakpoint from 900px to 1180px.
At <=1180px the page uses compact top navigation and stacked order/chart layout.
Wide desktop retains the Liquidity-Pool-style fixed left rail.
Advanced shared CSS cache URL to /xrbc-dynamic-ui.css?v=20260922-1.

manual_checks: Narrow desktop/tablet no longer shows oversized empty left rail.
Order panel stacks cleanly before chart.
